```{r}
ArrowFiles <- createArrowFiles(
  inputFiles = inputFiles,
  sampleNames = names(inputFiles),
  minTSS = 4,
  minFrags = 0, 
  addTileMat = TRUE,
  TileMatParams = list(tileSize = 500),
  addGeneScoreMat = TRUE
)
```

#create ArchR project
```{r}
proj <- ArchRProject(
  ArrowFiles = ArrowFiles, 
  outputDirectory = paste0(base_path, "ArchR"),
  copyArrows = FALSE
)

# Barcode Plate Index Linking
barcodes_file <- read_csv(file.path(base_path, "output.csv"))
bc_well_values <- sub(".*#", "", rownames(getCellColData(proj)))

proj <- addCellColData(
  ArchRProj = proj,
  data = bc_well_values,
  name = "BC_well",
  cells = getCellNames(proj),
  force = TRUE
)

barcodes_file <- barcodes_file %>%
  mutate(BC_well = paste(BCset.atac, Well_ID_indexPlate, sep = "_"))

position.atac <- match(proj$BC_well, barcodes_file$BC_well)
proj$RNA_ATAC_joint_bcs <- barcodes_file$RNA_ATAC_joint_bcs[position.atac]
proj$XC_DNBPE.rna       <- barcodes_file$XC_DNBPE.rna[position.atac]
proj$Well_ID_indexPlate <- barcodes_file$Well_ID_indexPlate[position.atac]
proj$plate_col          <- gsub("[A-Z]", "", proj$Well_ID_indexPlate)
proj$plate_row          <- gsub("[0-9]+", "", proj$Well_ID_indexPlate)

# Condition assignment
proj$condition <- case_when(
  proj$RNA_ATAC_joint_bcs == "21J_5B" ~ "unstained",
  proj$RNA_ATAC_joint_bcs == "16P_6D" ~ "stained",
  TRUE                                ~ NA_character_
)

proj <- proj[!is.na(proj$condition), ]
```

```{r}
Xpress.dgecounts <- readRDS("/mnt/data/user/francesco/projects/thesis/hpscs/FC02/SS3X/zUMIs/zUMIs_output/expression/Xpress.dgecounts.rds")
seurat_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = Xpress.dgecounts$readcount$inex$all)
seurat_obj$XC_DNBPE.rna <- colnames(seurat_obj)

position.rna <- match(seurat_obj$XC_DNBPE.rna, barcodes_file$XC_DNBPE.rna)
seurat_obj$RNA_ATAC_joint_bcs <- barcodes_file$RNA_ATAC_joint_bcs[position.rna]
seurat_obj <- subset(seurat_obj, subset = !is.na(RNA_ATAC_joint_bcs))

seurat_obj$condition <- case_when(
  seurat_obj$RNA_ATAC_joint_bcs == "21J_5B" ~ "unstained",
  seurat_obj$RNA_ATAC_joint_bcs == "16P_6D" ~ "stained",
  TRUE                                ~ NA_character_
)
seurat_obj$sample <- "nuclei"

# Convert ENSEMBL to Gene Symbol
gene_map <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys = rownames(seurat_obj),
  columns = "SYMBOL",
  keytype = "ENSEMBL"
)
gene_map <- gene_map[!duplicated(gene_map$ENSEMBL), ]
new_names <- ifelse(is.na(gene_map$SYMBOL), gene_map$ENSEMBL, gene_map$SYMBOL)
rownames(seurat_obj[["RNA"]]) <- make.unique(new_names)

seurat_obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat_obj, pattern = "^MT-")
seurat_obj[["percent.rb"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat_obj, pattern = "^RPS|^RPL")
```

```{r}

VlnPlot(seurat_obj, features = "nCount_RNA", log = TRUE,

  geom_hline(yintercept = max_nCount, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7)

VlnPlot(seurat_obj, features = "nFeature_RNA", 
        group.by = "sample") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = max_nFeature, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7)

VlnPlot(seurat_obj, features = "percent.mt",

```

```{r}
# Filtering Single-Cell Dataset
seurat_obj_filtered <- subset(
  seurat_obj,
subset =
(sample == "nuclei" & nFeature_RNA > 4000 & nFeature_RNA < 17000 & nCount_RNA > 10000 & percent.mt < 13)
)

# SCTransform & Dimensionality Reduction
seurat_obj_filtered <- SCTransform(
  seurat_obj_filtered,
  assay = "RNA",
  vst.flavor = "v2",
  vars.to.regress = c("percent.mt", "percent.rb"),
  variable.features.n = 3000,
  verbose = FALSE
) %>% 
  RunPCA()

Seurat::ElbowPlot(seurat_obj_filtered, ndims = 50, reduction = "pca")
```


```{r}
seurat_obj_filtered <- FindNeighbors(seurat_obj_filtered, dims = 1:20) %>% 
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.3) %>% 
  RunUMAP(dims = 1:20)

# Map RNA Clusters into ArchR Project
rna_clusters <- as.character(seurat_obj_filtered$seurat_clusters)
names(rna_clusters) <- colnames(seurat_obj_filtered)
rna_clusters_aligned <- rna_clusters[proj$XC_DNBPE.rna]

proj <- addCellColData(
  ArchRProj = proj,
  data = rna_clusters_aligned,
  name = "RNA_Clusters",
  cells = getCellNames(proj),
  force = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
my_colors <- c(
  "stained" = "#E64B35",  
  "unstained" = "#4DBBD5" 
)
qc_df <- getCellColData(proj) %>% as.data.frame()

# Custom Violin Function with Group Statistics
plot_violin <- function(df, metric_col, title_name, target_val = NULL, accept_val = NULL) {
  stats_df <- df %>%
    group_by(condition) %>%
    summarise(
      med = round(median(.data[[metric_col]], na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      avg = round(mean(.data[[metric_col]], na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      y_pos = max(.data[[metric_col]], na.rm = TRUE) * 1.12, 
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(label_text = paste0("Med: ", med, "\nAvg: ", avg))
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = condition, y = .data[[metric_col]], fill = condition)) +
    geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, color = "black", outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 23, size = 3, fill = "yellow") +
    geom_text(
      data = stats_df, 
      aes(x = condition, y = y_pos, label = label_text), 
      inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3.3, fontface = "bold", color = "darkblue", vjust = 0 
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(title = title_name, x = "Staining condition", y = metric_col) +
    my_theme +
    scale_fill_manual(values = my_colors) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.2))) + theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
    )
  
  if (!is.null(target_val)) {
    p <- p + geom_hline(yintercept = target_val, linetype = "dashed", color = "green4", size = 0.9)
  }
  if (!is.null(accept_val)) {
    p <- p + geom_hline(yintercept = accept_val, linetype = "dotted", color = "orange", size = 0.9)
  }
  
  return(p)
}

p_frip      <- plot_violin(qc_df, "FRIP", "Fraction of Reads in Peaks (FRiP)", target_val = NULL, accept_val = NULL)
p_tss       <- plot_violin(qc_df, "TSSEnrichment", "TSS Enrichment Score", target_val = NULL)
p_nfrags    <- plot_violin(qc_df, "nFrags", "Number of Fragments (nFrags)")
p_blacklist <- plot_violin(qc_df, "ReadsInBlacklist", "Reads in Blacklist")
p_frag_size <- plotFragmentSizes(ArchRProj = proj, groupBy = "condition") + scale_color_manual(values = my_colors) + my_theme

plots_QC <- (((p_frip | p_tss) / (p_nfrags | p_blacklist)) / p_frag_size) + 
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Quality Control Metrics across Staining Conditions",
    tag_levels = 'A'
  ) + 
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") & 
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", family = "Times New Roman", hjust = 0.5)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = "QC_metrics_violin.png", 
  plot = plots_QC,
  width = 10, 
  height = 12,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)
```

# Peak type distribution by condition
```{r}
peakSE <- getMatrixFromProject(ArchRProj = proj, useMatrix = "PeakMatrix")
peakSet_gr <- getPeakSet(proj)

mat <- assay(peakSE)
peak_types <- peakSet_gr$peakType

stopifnot(length(peak_types) == nrow(mat))

counts_by_type <- rowsum(as.matrix(mat), group = peak_types)
frac_by_type <- sweep(counts_by_type, 2, colSums(counts_by_type), "/")

frac_df <- as.data.frame(t(frac_by_type)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  pivot_longer(-cell, names_to = "peakType", values_to = "fraction") %>%
  left_join(
    data.frame(cell = rownames(getCellColData(proj)), condition = getCellColData(proj)$condition),
    by = "cell"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(condition))

summary_df <- frac_df %>%
  group_by(condition, peakType) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_frac = mean(fraction, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem = sd(fraction, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

barplot <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = condition, y = mean_frac, fill = peakType)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.5, color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = scales::percent(mean_frac, accuracy = 1)),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    color = "white", size = 3.5, fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Promoter" = "#D55E00",
    "Intronic" = "#0072B2",
    "Distal"   = "#009E73",
    "Exonic"   = "#CC79A7"
  )) +
  labs(
    x = NULL, y = "Fraction of accessible signal",
    title = "Distribution of ATAC signal by genomic feature type",
    fill = "Peak type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  my_theme
ggsave(filename = "./ArchR/Plots/peak_type_distribution.png", plot = barplot, width = 25, height = 15, dpi = 150, units = "cm")
```

#Library complexity curve (from preseq)
```{r}
cc <- read.table("/mnt/data/user/francesco/projects/scripts/preseq_output/FC02_nuclei_1_c_curve.txt", header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
lc <- read.table("/mnt/data/user/francesco/projects/scripts/preseq_output/FC02_nuclei_1_lc_extrap.txt", header = TRUE, sep = "\t")

max_cc_reads <- max(cc$total_reads)

lc_filtered <- lc %>% filter(TOTAL_READS >= max_cc_reads)

lc_curve <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = lc_filtered, 
              aes(x = TOTAL_READS / 1e6, ymin = LOWER_0.95CI / 1e6, ymax = UPPER_0.95CI / 1e6), 
              fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(data = cc, 
            aes(x = total_reads / 1e6, y = distinct_reads / 1e6, color = "Current data (c_curve)"), 
            size = 1.2) +
  
  geom_line(data = lc_filtered, 
            aes(x = TOTAL_READS / 1e6, y = EXPECTED_DISTINCT / 1e6, color = "Extrapolation (lc_extrap)"), 
            size = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Current data (c_curve)" = "#1f77b4", 
                               "Extrapolation (lc_extrap)" = "#ff7f0e")) +
  labs(
    title = "Library Complexity and Projection",
    x = "Total Reads (Millions)",
    y = "Distinct Reads (Millions)",
    color = "Curve"
  ) +
  my_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )

ggsave(filename = "/mnt/data/user/francesco/projects/thesis/hpscs/FC02/ATAC/ArchR/Plots/lc_curve.png", plot = lc_curve, width = 20, height = 15, dpi = 200, units = "cm")
```

# Joint RNA/ATAC visualization
```{r}
# Extract GeneScoreMatrix from ArchR
gene_score_se <- getMatrixFromProject(proj, useMatrix = "GeneScoreMatrix")
gene_score_mat <- assay(gene_score_se)
gene_names <- rowData(gene_score_se)$name

# Remove duplicated gene names and align barcodes
unique_genes <- !duplicated(gene_names)
gene_score_mat <- gene_score_mat[unique_genes, ]
rownames(gene_score_mat) <- gene_names[unique_genes]
colnames(gene_score_mat) <- proj$XC_DNBPE.rna

# Intersect cells surviving filtering in both datasets
common_cells <- intersect(colnames(gene_score_mat), colnames(seurat_obj_filtered))
gene_score_mat_common <- gene_score_mat[, common_cells]
seurat_joint <- subset(seurat_obj_filtered, cells = common_cells)

# Add ATAC GeneScore as a new assay to the Seurat object
seurat_joint[["ATAC_GeneScore"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = gene_score_mat_common)

# Plot RNA expression
DefaultAssay(seurat_joint) <- "SCT"
p_rna <- FeaturePlot(seurat_joint, features = c("PODXL", "PTMA"), reduction = "umap", order = TRUE, ncol = 1) & 
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma") & 
  my_theme

# Plot ATAC Gene Activity
DefaultAssay(seurat_joint) <- "ATAC_GeneScore"
p_atac <- FeaturePlot(seurat_joint, features = c("PODXL", "PTMA"), reduction = "umap", order = TRUE, ncol = 1) & 
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "viridis") & 
  my_theme

# Combine and save plots
joint_feature_plot <- (p_rna | p_atac) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A')

ggsave(
  filename = "Joint_RNA_ATAC_FeaturePlot.png", 
  plot = joint_feature_plot,
  width = 10, 
  height = 10,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)
```
